reason: Provides image generation and reference-image upload through the ToAPIs asynchronous API, with polling and workspace output downloads.

summaries.zh: 通过 ToAPIs 异步图像 API 生成图片、上传本地参考图，并将生成结果下载到工作区。
summaries.en: Generates images through the asynchronous ToAPIs image API, uploads local reference images, and downloads generated results into the workspace.

capabilities: Generates images through a third-party asynchronous API
Uploads local images to obtain public URLs
Downloads generated images into the workspace
Reads an API key from environment or local credentials configuration
